test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We met a lot of people _______ our stay in Ahmedabad.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the selection of the correct preposition.
 
• "During" is used to indicate a period of time in which something happens.
 
• In this context, **"during our stay in Ahmedabad" **correctly conveys that the meeting of people happened within the period of their stay.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We met a lot of people **during** our stay in Ahmedabad."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "while"** – Incorrect because "while" is used to indicate two simultaneous actions. It would be more appropriate for a clause, e.g., "We met a lot of people while we were staying in Ahmedabad."
 
• **Option 3: "on"** – Incorrect because "on" is typically used with specific days or dates, e.g., "on Monday."
 
• **Option 4: "in"** – Incorrect because "in" is used for longer periods of time such as months, years, or specific locations, but does not convey the duration as effectively as "during."
